name: FloatingLines-TS-TW

frames.best_why: Brightest violet ribbon sweeps the width with a second glowing bundle below it.

tagline: Glowing purple light ribbons drift across a dark haze.
summary: Soft bands of violet-blue light float across a dark magenta haze, bending and crossing as they drift. The pointer pushes the nearest lines so the ribbons flex around it.
appearance: Broad ribbons of glowing violet and blue light sweep low across a hazy dark purple field. The brightest strands read almost white at the core and fade into a soft magenta wash.
behaviour: The ribbons drift and bend slowly, crossing one another as their waves shift. Moving the pointer bends nearby lines and slides the whole scene a little.
demo_content: Purple-violet light lines on a dark haze with nothing else on the panel.
search_phrases: smooth neon lines for a hero
light waves that bend with the mouse
use_when: A dark hero wants soft glowing bands behind a headline instead of a photo.
avoid_when: The haze lifts the whole surface, so white overlay text needs a contrast check.
customise: Gradient colours, which wave layers show, line counts and distances, wave positions, speed, bend and parallax are props; the shader itself is fixed.
weight_why: A fullscreen shader is redrawn every frame on a three.js canvas.

a11y.note: A canvas backdrop with no labels; its continuous drift ignores reduced-motion settings.

polish_why: Glowing ribbons with a rich, smooth gradient; bands are soft and the palette is one purple family.
